messages:
maria: Heads up — main CI red after lock regen. macos-latest jobs failing when building grpcio wheel. @kevin @sara can you take a look? failing job: https://ci.internal/runs/47921
ci-bot: CI job macos-build #47921 failed on commit abc123 (main) — https://ci.internal/runs/47921
kevin: On it. which exact step is blowing up? can you paste the tail of the log?
maria: paste from the runner logs:
```
ERROR: Failed building wheel for grpcio
  running bdist_wheel
  error: command 'clang' failed with exit status 1
  ...
ld: library not found for -lssl

Building wheel for grpcio failed with error code 1
```
sara: That looks like the wheel expects a different macOS/openssl layout. Did the lock regen bump grpcio or a transitive like protobuf/openssl-binding?
kevin: I'll check lockfile diff now — if grpcio version changed that's the obvious suspect. I'll also try a local repro on a mac VM: `python -m pip install grpcio==1.52.0` to see if it pulls a problematic wheel/build.
devops-bot: Rerun requested by @kevin: https://ci.internal/runs/47921/retry (queued)
kevin: If rerun fails, plan is: 1) bisect lockfile between HEAD~1 and HEAD to find which transitive changed, 2) attempt temporary pin (grpcio==1.51.0) in pyproject to unblock CI, 3) open a short PR for the emergency pin + changelog.
sara: Sounds good. Quick note: we saw similar failures when grpcio moved to a wheel that needs newer SDK. If bisect shows grpcio bumped, prefer pinning to last known-good wheel rather than forcing a build from source.
maria: @kevin if you want me to open the emergency PR I can do it and mark it for expedited review. :thumbsup:
kevin: Thanks — I'll report back in ~15m after the rerun and a quick bisect. if anyone finds a simple repro command for mac runner, paste it here (I can forward to infra to run an isolated job).
sara: Repro command we use locally: `python -m pip install --no-binary=:all: grpcio` — that forces source build; if that fails with clang/ssl errors it's the same as CI.
maria: OK watching. ping me when you have a candidate lock commit to revert/pin so I can unblock deploys.
kevin: update: rerun still failing, starting bisect (git checkout HEAD~1..HEAD range) — will post commit id when I narrow it down.
ci-bot: Rerun failed: https://ci.internal/runs/47921 (status: failed)
kevin: bisect quick notes: lock diff shows grpcio bumped from 1.51.1 -> 1.52.0 via a transitive proto bump. hypothesis: pin grpcio to 1.51.1 in pyproject.lock to restore CI while we coordinate with research for a long-term fix.
sara: Agreed. I'll prepare a short note for release notes about mac wheel regression.
maria: Thanks all — will standby for the PR.
